description:
[Servers] Community leaderboard by votes or rating. Online servers ranked by Steam-authenticated community votes (one per user per server per day) or by
average 1-5 rating - the ranking behind servers.rustprofit.com/best-rust-servers and /leaderboard?by=rating.
Only servers with at least one vote (or rating) appear. Each entry is the full server record plus `rank`,
`votes`, `rating` and `last_wipe_at`. Cached for five minutes.

by.description: `votes` = most community votes (the site's Best Rust Servers page); `rating` = highest average rating, votes as tiebreaker.

limit.description: How many servers to return (1-100); the site shows 50.

name: get_server_leaderboard
title: Community leaderboard by votes or rating
